name: grok-imagine
description: Generate and edit images and videos with Grok Imagine, signed in through official Grok CLI OAuth (grok login).

interface.longDescription: Lets Codex create and edit images and videos with Grok Imagine, plus a local n8n-style flow canvas (open_flow_ui) to inspect and run image→video pipelines. Sign in with grok login --oauth.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 1:1 origami fox icon with Grok Imagine
Animate that frame into a 6s video
Open the Imagine flow canvas so I can control the pipeline
